directories.src/main/java/net/legendofwar/phoenix/au: Contains 6 module files (AuctionSearchFilter.java, ClaimMenuBuilder.java, PlayerAuctions.java, PagedClaimMenu.java)

deploy.sh.summary: This script automates the Maven build, packaging, and deployment of Minecraft plugin JAR files to local or remote server environments depending on the user.

README.md.summary: `README.md` documents the core game design for the Phoenix project, detailing mechanics for races, maps, buildings, quests, and player stats.

src/main/java/net/legendofwar/phoenix/En.summary: `EntityHPDisplayHandler` manages custom health bar overlays for entities viewed by players. As a core UI display utility, it tracks and updates entity HP packets within the project.

src/main/java/net/legendofwar/phoenix/au.summary: `AuctionSearchFilter` models persistent Redis-backed search and sorting criteria for auction items, exporting `DATA_GENERATOR` and `test(Item)`. It powers the project's auction house filtering system.

src/main/java/net/legendofwar/phoenix/Pl.summary: `PlayerHeaderNameHandler` manages dynamic player tab list prefixes and colors using scoreboards. It exports `init(Plugin)` to register event listeners for player joins, volk, and skill changes.

src/main/java/net/legendofwar/phoenix/Ph.summary: `Phoenix.java` is the core plugin entry point for the project, managing server initialization and event registrations. It primarily exports the `Phoenix` class.

src/main/java/net/legendofwar/phoenix/au.summary: `ClaimMenuBuilder` constructs interactive inventory menus for players to manage auction claims. Its primary exported class is `ClaimMenuBuilder`, featuring `buildClaimMenu`, to handle claim UI generation within the auction system.
`PlayerAuctions` manages player auction listings and GUIs within the auctions system. It acts as the core listener and manager class for handling player auction interactions.

`PagedClaimMenu` manages and displays a paginated inventory menu for player auction claims. It exports the `PagedClaimMenu` class, serving as the UI component for claiming auction items in the project.
`PlayerShop` manages the player marketplace UI and asynchronous data loading. It primarily exports `openPlayerShopAsync(Player)` to asynchronously open the shop inventory menu in the auction system.

`ItemGroup` is an abstract base class that manages auction shop entries and Redis data loading. It defines `getDisplayItem()`, `getInventoryMenu()`, and `getItemStorageKeys()` to categorize items in the auction system.
`ServerAuction` manages server-wide auction listings and synchronized data using Redis locks. It exports `getNewAuctionItem()` and handles core auction mechanics within the project's economy system.
